releaseNotes:
## Guest Inbox

- Dismiss is removed. When an email is dealt with, move the conversation to another mailbox folder.
- Mark read and Mark unread update the message in Outlook.
- Delete moves the conversation to Trash. It does not erase it.
- Move, Delete, and Mark read/unread can be undone for a few seconds.
- Back to Guest Inbox sits on its own row, away from Reply.
- The old Dismissed stage is now labeled Closed.

## Schedule

- View availability opens the Monthly calendar in a separate window, on the arrival month, and highlights the dates being checked.
- The email or inquiry stays open, including unsaved details.
- The same window is reused the next time you check dates.
- Inquiry pages with dates have the same action.
